mode.title: Mode
mode.description: search runs the portal sources (none registered in WP0, so zero listings). katastr_lookup returns NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

profile.title: Search profile
profile.description: Search profile, validated against profile.schema.json. See README.md.

notion.title: Notion
notion.description: Notion target. Without dataSourceId, results go to the dataset only.

dataSourceId.title: Data source ID
dataSourceId.description: Notion data source ID of the DOMOVOY shortlist database. Used from WP7; WP0 does not read it.

notionToken.title: Notion token
notionToken.description: Notion integration token. Used by the Notion sink (WP7); WP0 does not read it.

llm.title: LLM settings
llm.description: Featherless extraction settings. Used from WP4; WP0 does not read them.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Parallel LLM calls. Matches the Featherless plan limit.

fallbackModel.title: Fallback model
fallbackModel.description: OpenAI model id, used when Featherless fails.

featherlessApiKey.title: Featherless API key
featherlessApiKey.description: Featherless API key. Used by extraction (WP4); WP0 does not read it.

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI API key
openaiApiKey.description: OpenAI API key for the extraction fallback (WP4); WP0 does not read it.

includeUnchanged.title: Include unchanged flats
includeUnchanged.description: Emit flats that did not change since the last run.

skipExtraction.title: Skip extraction
skipExtraction.description: Debug only. WP0 logs this flag; there is no extraction step yet.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Off. Apify Proxy is paid, so turning it on is a team decision.
